rates.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CN codes to those products. Pursuant to Article 41(2),146ef(1)(2) item 14 of Annex 3 to Act of 11 March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax reduced rate is applied to pharmaceutical products admitted to trading in the territory of Poland in accordance with the provisions of Act of 6 September 2001-Pharmaceutical Law and those that have obtained a permit issued by the Council of the EU or the European Commission (regardless of CN).

rates.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CN codes with respect to those items. Pursuant to Article 41(2), 146ef(1)(2), item 13 of Annex 3 to Act of 11 March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax reduced rate is applied to medical devices, accessories for medical devices, systems and procedure packs within the meaning of the Regulation (EU)2017/745 of The European Parliament and of the Council of 5 April 2017 on medical devices,  admitted to trading in the territory of Poland

rates.category_description: Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CPA codes with respect to those services. Pursuant to Article 41(2), 146ef(1)(2), item 64, 65, 66, 68 of Annex 3 to Act of 11 March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax reduced rate is applied to admission to (regardless of CPA codes): artistic performances,including circus performances, cultural facilities;amusement parks,theme parks, discos, dance halls; libraries, archives, museums and other cultural services; other services related to leisure.

rates.category_description: Reception of radio and television broadcasting services
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CPA codes to those services. Pursuant to Article 41(2), 146ef(1)(2),item 48 of Annex 3 to Act of 11March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax, the 8% rate is applied to services, other than electronic services (regardless of CPA codes), consisting in enabling reception of TV and radio programmes, within the meaning of Radio and TV Broadcasting regulations,by means of reception facilities,excluding rental of films and programmes at a time chosen by the recipient.

rates.category_description: Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CPA codes with respect to those services. Pursuant to Article 41(2), 146ef(1)(2) item 63 of Annex 3 to Act of 11 March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax reduced rate is applied to services of authors and performers within the meaning of the Act of 4 February 1994 on copyright and related rights remunerated in the form of fees for the transfer or licensing of copyrights or rights to artistic performance (regardless of CPA codes).

rates.category_description: Provision, construction, renovation and alteration of housing, as part of a social policy
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CPA codes to those services. The 8% rate is applied to services regarding building structures or parts thereof included in house-construction covered by a social housing programme within the meaning of and in line with the rules laid down in Article 41, paragraphs 12-12e of Act of 11 March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax.

rates.category_description: The renovation and repair of private dwellings, excluding materials which account for a significant part of the value of the service supplied
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CPA codes to those services. The 8% rate is applied to services regarding building structures or parts thereof included in house-construction covered by a social housing programme within the meaning of and in line with the rules laid down in Article 41, paragraphs 12-12e of Act of 11 March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax.

rates.category_description: Admission to sporting events
rates.comment: The Polish VAT rules do not provide for CPA codes with respect to those services. Pursuant to Article 41(2), 146ef(1)(2), item 67 of Annex 3 to Act of 11 March 2004 on Goods and Services Tax the VAT reduced rate is applied to admission to sporting events regardless of CPA codes.
